evaluator.rankingOrder: Lane scoreOrder metrics descending, then lastActivity descending, then case-sensitive address ascending.
evaluator.addressFilter: Implicit tz1, tz2, tz3, and tz4 addresses only.
evaluator.objktIdentityFilter: Flagged OBJKT buyers, creators, and minters are excluded.
evaluator.objktSaleDedupe: Each listing_sale id is one event even when several sales share an operation hash.
evaluator.objktSelfTradeFilter: Buyer creator legs are excluded; independent co-creator legs retain equal-share attribution.
evaluator.successfulDrop: Only tokens first created in the season qualify; each needs a unique positive-price primary sale from its creator to an independent unflagged implicit buyer, and remints/later resales do not count.
evaluator.appCalls: Applied top-level calls from implicit senders to the frozen resolved address-to-app map; nonce-bearing internal calls are excluded.
evaluator.contractResolution: TzKT smart_contract and asset catalogs are queried in separately bounded recent-activity slices, merged by address, then matched to the curated alias taxonomy so asset-kind pools are not crowded out or omitted.
evaluator.governanceStreak: Consecutive participation in the ordered actionable proposal, exploration, and promotion sequence; testing/cooldown and adoption windows are skipped.
evaluator.delegationRetention: Latest in-season assignment must change baker, be non-self, match delegate at snapshot/exact close, and retain positive liquid balance; this is identical in live and historical-close evaluation.
evaluator.liquiditySupply: Only frozen app/address mappings and reviewed positive-supply entrypoints count; targets are called venues and do not imply amount or LP duration.
evaluator.builderUse: Direct top-level originations from an implicit sender need post-deploy use from another implicit account; factory/internal originations are excluded.
evaluator.pagination: OBJKT id-keyset ascending with strict unique-cursor validation, 500×1000; TzKT 10000×60. A capped source withholds only dependent lanes.
evaluator.passportDepth: Every exhaustively observed eligible address receives participation progress; public standings remain capped at the deep ranking limit.
evaluator.champions: Active rank-one state is provisional; season-specific champion badges are minted only by the exact settled finalization rebuild.
evaluator.crossSeasonComeback: Compared per lane when that lane evaluator and rule hash match. DeFi, Gaming, and Liquidity additionally require their semantic frozen-contract coverage hash to match; volatile provenance never blocks unrelated lanes.
evaluator.rolloverFinalization: The new board opens at protocol activation while the prior season settles concurrently for 24 hours. The frozen generator cannot change until the prior exact-boundary rebuild closes; a true scoring upgrade requires versioned evaluator modules.
evaluator.championArchive: Only finalized summaries publish an explicit champions array, exactly matching ready rank-one lanes including Unicorn.

transaction.title: Transaction Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Transaction Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: A sustained season participant, separate from the unbounded all-time Crown Hall counter.

transaction.method: Most successful top-level transactions sent during the protocol season, then distinct active days.
transaction.coverage: Requires an exhaustive TzKT operation scan; no winner is published when the bounded source cannot be exhausted.

collector.title: Collector Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Collector Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Rewards collecting breadth across a meaningful set of artists without depending on a moving leaderboard cutoff.

collector.method: Most distinct unflagged artists collected through OBJKT listing sales during the protocol season; buy volume and purchase count break ties.
collector.coverage: OBJKT-indexed listing sales only. Private transfers and sales outside the OBJKT index are not counted.

artist.title: Art Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Art Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Rewards independent collector spread rather than relying on one high-value sale.

artist.method: Most distinct unflagged, non-self collectors of an artist's work in OBJKT listing sales during the protocol season; attributed volume and sales break ties.
artist.coverage: Collaborative-token volume is divided equally across unflagged creators so a single sale is not multiplied.

minter.title: Mint Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Mint Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Three independently purchased primary drops demonstrates repeat success without rewarding mint spam.

minter.method: Most season-minted tokens with a positive-price primary creator sale to an independent collector, then distinct mints, collectors, and primary-sale editions.
minter.coverage: OBJKT-indexed, non-reverted mint events for tokens first created during the season, joined to positive-price primary OBJKT listing sales. Remints of older tokens are excluded.

defi.title: DeFi Maxi

passportMilestone.label: DeFi Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Three recognized apps represents cross-application participation rather than repetitive calls to one contract.

defi.method: Most distinct recognized DeFi apps used during the protocol season, then successful top-level wallet calls and recognized contracts.
defi.coverage: Curated TzKT-alias taxonomy. Unknown, unlabeled, or newly deployed app contracts are outside coverage until the next season taxonomy is frozen.

gaming.title: Gaming Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Gaming Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Two recognized games establishes breadth while the curated Tezos gaming universe remains compact.

gaming.method: Most distinct recognized Tezos games used during the protocol season, then successful top-level wallet calls and recognized contracts.
gaming.coverage: Curated TzKT-alias taxonomy. Unknown, unlabeled, or newly deployed game contracts are outside coverage until the next season taxonomy is frozen.

governance.title: Governance Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Governance Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Two actionable proposal, exploration, or promotion windows demonstrates repeat governance participation.

governance.method: Most distinct actionable Tezos voting windows participated in during the protocol season, then streak across the ordered proposal, exploration, and promotion sequence and ballots plus proposals.
governance.coverage: Applied TzKT ballot and proposal operations attributed to implicit delegates.

staking.title: Staking Growth Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Staking Growth Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: A fixed 1,000 ꜩ net season increase is substantial but reachable without comparing against whale balances.

staking.method: Largest positive net stake added by a staker during the protocol season, then gross stake and stake-operation count.
staking.coverage: Applied TzKT staking operations. This trajectory lane is separate from the live absolute-stake Crown Hall.

delegation.title: Delegation Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Delegation Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Five retained in-season assignments is a human-scale baker growth milestone independent of absolute stake.

delegation.method: Most non-self wallets whose latest in-season assignment changed baker and still points to that baker with positive account balance, then retained balance.
delegation.coverage: Applied TzKT delegation operations reconciled against snapshot or exact-close state. This is retained in-season assignment, not proof of first-ever acquisition or marketing attribution.

liquidity.title: Liquidity Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Liquidity Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: Two recognized liquidity contracts rewards breadth while value and duration remain non-comparable.

liquidity.method: Most recognized liquidity contracts reached through frozen positive-supply entrypoints, then app breadth and successful top-level calls.
liquidity.coverage: Partial entrypoint coverage only; a distinct target is called a venue, not assumed to be one pool. Supplied value and LP duration are not scored.

bridge.title: Bridge Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Bridge Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: A small repeat-use target is declared now but remains unavailable until canonical attribution is frozen.

bridge.method: Canonical Etherlink L1 deposits during the protocol season. Withdrawals and round trips are deliberately excluded.
bridge.coverage: A winner is published only when the canonical L1 deposit contract and attribution semantics are frozen and exhaustively queryable.

builder.title: Builder Maxi

passportMilestone.label: Builder Maxi
passportMilestone.rationale: One season deployment with verified independent use is the meaningful builder threshold.

builder.method: Most directly originated contracts from an implicit sender that received successful post-deploy use from another implicit account, then user and call breadth.
builder.coverage: Conservative TzKT scope: top-level direct originations only. Factory/internal originations and deployments without independent use do not qualify.

unicorn.title: Season Unicorn

passportMilestone.label: Season Unicorn
passportMilestone.rationale: The prestige milestone is fixed at three same-season top-100 merit lanes.

unicorn.method: Breadth across same-season top 100 merit lanes; normalized rank points break ties. Requires 3 lanes.
unicorn.coverage: Only ready on-chain season lanes participate. Social sharing never contributes to Unicorn.

socialProof.reason: Shares and rank-card clicks are off-chain ritual signals and never change an on-chain merit rank or Unicorn.
